cards.example_en: Farm workers finish apple processing before sunset.
cards.example_zh: 农场工人在日落前完成苹果的加工。

cards.example_en: Chocolate pudding was still warm when we sat down.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐下时，巧克力布丁还是热的。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：舒适的
cards.example_en: These comfortable trainers are what I wear for long walks.
cards.example_zh: 我走远路时就穿这双舒适的运动鞋。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：负责的
cards.example_en: Everyone is responsible for keeping the classroom clean.
cards.example_zh: 每个人都有责任保持教室干净整洁。

cards.example_en: A lost animal was sleeping near the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 一只走失的动物睡在学校大门附近。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：至关重要的
cards.example_en: Sleep is crucial for good health.
cards.example_zh: 睡眠对身体健康至关重要。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：个别的
cards.example_en: Each student received individual feedback on the essay.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生都收到了针对作文的个别反馈。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：大量的
cards.example_en: We made a substantial donation of books to the library.
cards.example_zh: 我们向图书馆捐赠了大量图书。

cards.example_en: A councillor came to ask which playground we use most.
cards.example_zh: 一位议员来问我们最常去哪个操场。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：持有人
cards.example_en: Each pass holder may enter the museum without paying.
cards.example_zh: 每位通行证持有人都可以免费进入博物馆。

cards.example_en: The group leader checked that everyone had a torch.
cards.example_zh: 组长检查了每个人是否都带了手电筒。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：制造商
cards.example_en: A local manufacturer supplies desks to schools in the county.
cards.example_zh: 当地一家制造商给全县的学校供应课桌。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：出版商
cards.example_en: The publisher donated dictionaries to our library.
cards.example_zh: 出版商向我们图书馆捐赠了词典。

cards.example_en: A large spider sat in the web above the shed door.
cards.example_zh: 一只大蜘蛛停在棚屋门上方的网上。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：巨大的
cards.example_en: A massive wave knocked the small boat sideways.
cards.example_zh: 一个巨浪把小船打得歪到一边。
